Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Wikipedia lists Jorge Brum do Canto’s birth year as 1930 even after the most recent WebSurfer result showed Wikipedia giving 1910. This failure to update based on new evidence preserved a false discrepancy (IMDb 1910 vs. Wikipedia 1930) and could directly lead to the wrong conclusion about which film’s director was born earlier.
